title: British Airways parent profit drops on higher fuel costs
description: IAG, the owner of British Airways and Iberia, said Friday that its net profit dropped more than 12 percent in the third quarter on soaring fuel costs and flight disruptions caused by the Middle East conflict. The group said its overall flight capacity had been hit "by cancellations due to the conflict in the Middle East, together with aircraft availability linked to engine issues and disruption related to air traffic control disruption".

title: Trump Media's investors lost $2.2 billion while Trump holds $460 million stake

Many investors had high hopes for the social media platform, believing in its potential profitability under Trump's leadership. Instead, Trump Media's shares have lost significant value, and discontent among shareholders has grown. The company's revenue remains stagnant, leading investors to question management practices and investor trust.

title: Copper falls for 4th day, heads for worst week since March on AI rout

The three-month copper rate on the London Metal Exchange fell to a low not seen since late July. While tight supply, particularly outside the US, has cushioned further losses, a significant drop in copper stocks within Chinese warehouses is intensifying supply anxieties.

title: Siemens Q2 Results: Profit grows 5% to Rs 504 crore
description: Siemens Limited announced a consolidated net profit of Rs 504 crore for the quarter ending September 30, 2026. This represents a 4.78% increase compared to the previous year's profit of Rs 481 crore. Revenue from operations grew significantly to Rs 5,734 crore, up from Rs 4,900 crore a year prior. Additionally, new orders reached Rs 6,228 crore, a notable 38% increase year-over-year.

Significant foreign inflows into Indian equities and a sharp fall in oil prices are key factors. Analysts suggest India's equity markets may attract global investments as concerns about AI infrastructure spending grow. The Reserve Bank of India announced measures to support the rupee against maintaining fluctuations.
